info.title: CN Work Agent API
info.description: On-prem Feishu / DingTalk / WeCom webhook agent (local mock connectors; stdlib only). Documents `/health`, `/ready`, **`GET /v1/platforms`** (product inventory `{ok,count,platforms:[{id,enabled,hasCallbackSecret}]}`; never tokens / callbackSecret / encrypt keys; health still lists platform id strings), **`GET /v1/config`** (redacted runtime config `{ok,approvalTtlSec,rateLimit:{perMinute},cors:{origins},approvalsMax,webhooks:{hasUrl,hasSecret},platforms}`; public GET, no admin token; never callbackSecret / webhook URL / webhook secret / FEISHU_* tokens / Authorization), `GET /metrics`, `/webhook/feishu`, `/webhook/dingtalk`, `/webhook/wecom`, `GET /approvals`, `GET /approvals/{id}`, `POST /approvals/{id}/decide`, **`GET /v1/approvals.csv`** (audit CSV), **`GET /v1/approvals.md`** (Markdown list), **`GET /v1/approvals.html`** (HTML list; `format=html`), `GET /v1/approvals?format=csv|json|md|html`. `GET /ready` is **200** `{ok:true, service}` plus the same snapshot fields as `/health` when healthy (stateless; no circuit/queue). On SIGTERM/SIGINT, **503** `{ok:false, reason:"shutting_down"}` (liveness `GET /health` stays 200 with `shuttingDown: true` while draining). Compose/stack-demo healthchecks stay on `/health`. `GET /openapi.json` serves this file. Optional `serve --watch`: poll `--config` mtime (~300ms) and reload CORS origins, approval TTL, webhook url/secret, and rate limits from file (env still wins if already set; CLI flags still win when provided). Parse errors keep the previous settings. Prints `regenerated` on success. Main serve / stack-demo omit `--watch`. Optional `X-Request-Id` request header: echoed on **every** response (including 4xx / OPTIONS / 429). If omitted or empty, the server generates a UUID (max 128 chars; CR/LF stripped). The same value is stored as `requestId` on approval records and audit JSONL. **401**: webhook verify failure (`{error:"unauthorized",reason}`) when Feishu token/signature, DingTalk token/sign, or WeCom `msg_signature` is missing/wrong. **429**: webhook rate limit (`RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE` default 60; in-memory sliding window by IP + platform). Exceed → `{error:"rate_limited",limit,retry_after}` + `Retry-After`. `/health`, `/ready`, `/metrics`, `/openapi.json`, `/v1/platforms`, `/v1/config`, `/approvals`, `/v1/approvals.csv`, `/v1/approvals.md`, and `/v1/approvals.html` are not rate-limited. **403 CORS**: optional `CORS_ORIGINS` CSV / config `cors.origins` / `--cors-origins` (`*` allowed). Default omitted/empty = no extra CORS headers (deny; OPTIONS **404**). When enabled with an explicit list, OPTIONS preflight for a listed Origin → **204** with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` / `Allow-Methods` / `Allow-Headers`; unlisted Origin (e.g. `http://evil.example`) → **403** `{error:"forbidden",reason:"cors_denied"}` (no ACAO). Matching GET/POST include ACAO. Default allow/expose headers include `X-Request-Id`. Default `Access-Control-Expose-Headers` includes `Retry-After` and `X-Request-Id` (browser JS can read 429 `Retry-After`). Approval TTL: `APPROVAL_TTL_SECONDS` (default 86400) auto-rejects pending older than TTL with `reason=expired`. Decided-approvals cap (OSS): `--approvals-max` / env `APPROVALS_MAX` (config `approvals_max`) default **2000** decided (`approved`/`rejected`/`expired`) JSONL rows. Over cap, drop oldest decided by `created_at`. Pending within TTL are never dropped. `0` = unlimited. `GET /approvals`, `GET /v1/approvals.csv`, `GET /v1/approvals.md`, `GET /v1/approvals.html`, and cards only see retained rows; `GET /approvals/{id}` → **404** if dropped. Webhook already fired at decide/expire. `GET /metrics` Prometheus text (gauge `cn_work_agent_approvals_pending` from JSONL; counters `cn_work_agent_approvals_decided_total`, `cn_work_agent_webhooks_total` process-lifetime; CORS matching GET includes ACAO, same as other GET). Optional approval-decision webhook (OSS): `--webhook-url` or env `APPROVAL_WEBHOOK_URL` (config `approval_webhook_url`). When an approval is decided (`approve`/`reject`) or TTL-expired, fire-and-forget POST JSON `{id,status,decision,reason,requestId}` (short timeout; webhook errors never fail decide/expire). Every outbound POST includes `X-Webhook-Timestamp: <unix-seconds>` (HMAC still signs the raw body only). Optional `--webhook-secret` or env `APPROVAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (config `approval_webhook_secret`): when set, POST includes `X-Webhook-Signature: sha256=<hex>` HMAC-SHA256 of the raw JSON body. On 5xx or network/timeout, OSS retries the POST once after ~50ms (success on first try = no retry; 4xx do not retry). Simple HMAC is OSS; exponential backoff / queues, key rotation, and timestamp replay window enforcement = paid later. **`GET /v1/approvals/{id}/card?platform=feishu|dingtalk|wecom`** returns the JSON body F would POST to that IM for an approval request (Feishu interactive card with `header`/`elements` and approve/reject buttons; DingTalk `msgtype=actionCard`; WeCom `msgtype=textcard`). Buttons point at existing `POST /approvals/{id}/decide` URLs when `base_url` is set, else `https://example.invalid/approve?id=`. No tokens/HMAC/`sk-` secrets in the card. Title/reason from approval `text`/`reason`. Unknown id → **404**. Unknown `platform` → **400** `bad_platform`. Not rate-limited. See `ImCard`. See `ApprovalDecisionWebhook`. Optional **Dify / n8n sample forward** (adapter only, not a Dify plugin): `--forward-url` or env `APPROVAL_FORWARD_URL` (config `approval_forward_url`). When an approval is approved or rejected (including TTL expire), fire-and-forget POST JSON `{event,approval_id,status,tenant|app,title}` (no secrets/notes/tokens in the body; OSS 1 retry on 5xx/timeout). Empty/omit = disabled. Optional HMAC (default off): env `APPROVAL_FORWARD_SECRET` / `--forward-secret` / `approval_forward_secret` → `X-Webhook-Signature: sha256=<hex>` of the raw JSON body (same as B/E). See `ApprovalForwardWebhook`. Optional **inbound IM decide HMAC (OSS)**: per-platform `callbackSecret` (aliases `callback_secret`, `verificationToken`, `appSecret`; env `FEISHU_CALLBACK_SECRET` / `DINGTALK_CALLBACK_SECRET` / `WECOM_CALLBACK_SECRET` or `APPROVAL_CALLBACK_SECRET`). Default **off** — unsigned POST `/approvals/{id}/decide` still **200** (local-mvp). When set for the approval's platform, **POST** requires `X-Callback-Signature: sha256=<hex>` HMAC-SHA256 of the **raw JSON body** (same style as outbound `X-Webhook-Signature`; timing-safe compare). Optional `X-Callback-Timestamp: <unix-seconds>` — reject if |now-ts| > **300s** (`timestamp_skew`). Missing/bad signature → **401** `{error:"unauthorized",reason}` (never leaks the secret). **GET** `/approvals/{id}/decide?decision=approve|reject` stays **unsigned** (IM card button URLs cannot carry HMAC; OSS convenience). Production should use POST + signature; Feishu/DingTalk/WeCom adapters can copy `X-Callback-Signature` in production later. Does not reuse IM `verify_token` / `encrypt_key` / DingTalk `secret`.

tags.name: health
tags.description: Liveness (GET /health always 200; shuttingDown true while draining) and readiness (GET /ready 200 when healthy, 503 shutting_down while draining)

tags.name: webhooks
tags.description: Feishu / DingTalk / WeCom mock webhooks (verify + rate-limit)

tags.name: approvals
tags.description: Local JSONL approval list / get / decide (TTL auto-reject; decided cap `--approvals-max`) + audit CSV export + Markdown list (`GET /v1/approvals.md`) + HTML list (`GET /v1/approvals.html`) + native IM card payloads (`GET /v1/approvals/{id}/card`)

tags.name: platforms
tags.description: Configured IM connectors (feishu / dingtalk / wecom). GET /v1/platforms is the product list; /health still exposes id strings only. Never secrets.

tags.name: config
tags.description: Redacted runtime config for intranet-pilot debugging (GET /v1/config). Public GET like /v1/platforms — no admin token — so the payload is strictly non-secret (TTL, rate-limit, CORS origins, approvals-max, webhook booleans, platforms). Never secrets.

200.description: Agent is up (platforms, rate-limit, approval TTL)

get.description: Readiness. **200** `{ok:true, service}` plus `platforms` / `enabled` / `rate_limit_per_minute` / `approval_ttl_seconds` / `approvals_max` (same as `/health`) when healthy. On SIGTERM/SIGINT, **503** `{ok:false, reason:"shutting_down"}` (liveness `GET /health` stays 200 with `shuttingDown: true`). Stateless HTTP — no circuit/queue. Not rate-limited. Compose/stack-demo healthchecks stay on `/health`.

200.description: Ready (same snapshot fields as GET /health). 200 when healthy; 503 `{ok:false, reason:"shutting_down"}` while draining SIGTERM/SIGINT.

503.description: Not ready: process is shutting down after SIGTERM/SIGINT. `{ok:false, reason:"shutting_down"}`. GET /health stays 200 with `shuttingDown: true` while draining.

get.description: Prometheus text exposition of local approval/webhook gauges and counters. Gauge: `cn_work_agent_approvals_pending` (JSONL pending count; scrape does not run expire_due). Counters: `cn_work_agent_approvals_decided_total` (approve/reject/TTL expire, process lifetime), `cn_work_agent_webhooks_total` (outbound approval-decision webhook attempts, process lifetime). CORS: matching Origin GET includes ACAO (same as other GET). Unlisted Origin OPTIONS → **403** `cors_denied`.

text/plain.example:
# TYPE cn_work_agent_approvals_pending gauge
cn_work_agent_approvals_pending 0
# TYPE cn_work_agent_approvals_decided_total counter
cn_work_agent_approvals_decided_total 1
# TYPE cn_work_agent_webhooks_total counter
cn_work_agent_webhooks_total 0

get.description: Product inventory of configured IM connectors. Always includes the known three (`feishu`, `dingtalk`, `wecom`) plus any extra ids already present in config `platforms` (list items or object keys). Each row is `{id, enabled, hasCallbackSecret}`. **Never** returns `callbackSecret`, verify tokens, encrypt keys, DingTalk `secret`, or WeCom `token`. `/health` still lists platform id strings only — this path is the HTTP product list. CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other GET. Not rate-limited (webhook limiter does not apply).

Public intranet-pilot snapshot of non-secret runtime settings. Same auth as `GET /v1/platforms` (no admin token). Allowlist only: `approvalTtlSec`, `rateLimit.perMinute`, `cors.origins`, `approvalsMax`, `webhooks.hasUrl` / `webhooks.hasSecret` (booleans — **never** the webhook URL, which may contain query tokens, and **never** the secret), plus `platforms` rows `{id,enabled,hasCallbackSecret}`. **Forbidden:** `callbackSecret`, webhook secret, `FEISHU_*` tokens, `Authorization`, verify tokens, encrypt keys. CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other GET. Not rate-limited (webhook limiter does not apply).

post.description: Local Feishu mock. URL verification `type=url_verification` echoes `challenge`. Messages route through shared intents (ping/help/digest/approval/echo). Verify: `FEISHU_VERIFY_TOKEN` in JSON `token` and optional Lark signature headers (`X-Lark-Request-Timestamp` / `X-Lark-Request-Nonce` / `X-Lark-Signature`) with `FEISHU_ENCRYPT_KEY`. Bad verify → **401**. Rate limit (IP+platform) → **429** + `Retry-After`. CORS: OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied` (see info). Incoming `X-Request-Id` stored on created approvals.

parameters.name: X-Lark-Request-Timestamp
parameters.description: Lark-style timestamp used with encrypt_key signature

200.description: Challenge echo or message ack (may include approval_id)

post.description: Local DingTalk mock. Callback JSON often has `text.content`. Verify: `DINGTALK_TOKEN` in JSON `token` and optional `X-DingTalk-Timestamp` + `X-DingTalk-Sign` with `DINGTALK_SECRET`. Bad verify → **401**. Rate limit → **429** + `Retry-After`. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`.

get.description: GET with `echostr` for URL verification. `msg_signature` = sha1(sort(token, timestamp, nonce, echostr)). Success returns **plain** echostr body. Bad signature → **401**. Rate limit → **429**. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`.

post.description: POST message (`Content` / `text`). Query `msg_signature` / `timestamp` / `nonce` verified with `WECOM_TOKEN`. Bad verify → **401**. Rate limit → **429** + `Retry-After`. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`.

get.description: List pending first, then recent. Runs `expire_due` first (TTL auto-reject). `?status=pending|approved|rejected|expired` filters (unknown/empty → 200 empty list); `?limit=` default 50. `?format=csv` → same audit CSV as `GET /v1/approvals.csv`; `?format=md` → same Markdown as `GET /v1/approvals.md`; `?format=html` → same HTML as `GET /v1/approvals.html`; `?format=json` or omit → JSON. Unknown format → **400** `bad_format`. Not rate-limited. CORS notes in info.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter rows. Allowed: `pending`, `approved`, `rejected`, `expired` (`expired` matches TTL auto-rejects: store `status=rejected` + `reason=expired`). Unknown or empty → **200** empty list (JSON `{ok:true,count:0,approvals:[]}`; CSV/MD/HTML header-only). Omit → unfiltered.

# Approvals
| id | platform | status | createdAt | decidedAt | reason |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

get.description: Spreadsheet archive of approval decisions (CN 内审). Header `id,platform,status,createdAt,decidedAt,reason` from JSONL (`created_at` → `createdAt`; `updated_at` → `decidedAt` when approved/rejected). Includes TTL auto-rejects (`status=rejected`, `reason=expired`). Does **not** include message `text`, `note`, tokens, or webhook HMAC. Empty store → header-only **200**. Runs `expire_due` first. `?status=pending|approved|rejected|expired` / `?limit=` optional (default all rows; unknown status → header-only 200). CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other GET. Access-logged (not skipped like `/metrics`). Alias: `GET /v1/approvals?format=csv` (also `GET /approvals?format=csv`). Markdown: `GET /v1/approvals.md` / `?format=md`. HTML: `GET /v1/approvals.html` / `?format=html`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter rows. Allowed: `pending`, `approved`, `rejected`, `expired` (`expired` matches TTL auto-rejects: store `status=rejected` + `reason=expired`). Unknown or empty → **200** empty list (JSON `{ok:true,count:0,approvals:[]}`; CSV/MD/HTML header-only). Omit → unfiltered.

200.description: CSV audit export (header + rows; header only when empty)

Heading `# Approvals` plus columns `id | platform | status | createdAt | decidedAt | reason` (same mapping as `GET /v1/approvals.csv`). `|` in cells is escaped. Does **not** include message `text`, `note`, tokens, or webhook HMAC. Empty store → heading + header row only, **200**. Runs `expire_due` first. `?status=pending|approved|rejected|expired` / `?limit=` optional (default all rows; unknown status → header-only 200). CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other GET. Access-logged (not skipped like `/metrics`). Alias: `GET /v1/approvals?format=md` (also `GET /approvals?format=md`). HTML: `GET /v1/approvals.html` / `?format=html`.

get.description: Self-contained HTML approval list for the local 5-min demo (no CDN / external CSS/JS). Heading `Approvals` plus a table of `id`, `platform`, `status`, `title`, `created`, `decided`, `reason` (CSV/MD columns plus title/summary from approval `text`). All text escaped (`& < > "`). Pending vs decided/expired rows are visually distinct (inline CSS). Empty store → heading + “no approvals”, **200**. Runs `expire_due` first. `?status=pending|approved|rejected|expired` / `?limit=` optional (default all rows; unknown status → header-only 200). CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other GET. Access-logged (not skipped like `/metrics`). Alias: `GET /v1/approvals?format=html` (also `GET /approvals?format=html`).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter rows. Allowed: `pending`, `approved`, `rejected`, `expired` (`expired` matches TTL auto-rejects: store `status=rejected` + `reason=expired`). Unknown or empty → **200** empty list (JSON `{ok:true,count:0,approvals:[]}`; CSV/MD/HTML header-only). Omit → unfiltered.

200.description: HTML approval list (heading + table; heading + “no approvals” when empty)

get.description: Versioned approval list. Query `status=pending|approved|rejected|expired` filters (unknown/empty → 200 empty list; omit → unfiltered). Query `format=json` (default) is the same body as `GET /approvals`. `format=csv` is the same `text/csv` body as `GET /v1/approvals.csv`. `format=md` is the same `text/markdown` body as `GET /v1/approvals.md`. Unknown format → **400** `{error:"bad_format"}`. Existing `/approvals` clients are unchanged. Runs `expire_due` first. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`. Access-logged (not skipped like `/metrics`). `format=html` is the same `text/html` body as `GET /v1/approvals.html`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter rows. Allowed: `pending`, `approved`, `rejected`, `expired` (`expired` matches TTL auto-rejects: store `status=rejected` + `reason=expired`). Unknown or empty → **200** empty list (JSON `{ok:true,count:0,approvals:[]}`; CSV/MD/HTML header-only). Omit → unfiltered.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max rows (JSON default 50; CSV omit = all)

get.summary: IM card payload for an approval
get.description: JSON body F would POST to Feishu / DingTalk / WeCom for this approval (native card, not a raw JSONL blob). Query `platform=feishu|dingtalk|wecom` (omit → use the approval's stored platform). Feishu: interactive card (`msg_type=interactive`, `header` + markdown `elements` + Approve/Reject URL buttons). DingTalk: `msgtype=actionCard`. WeCom: `msgtype=textcard`. Buttons use `{base}/approvals/{id}/decide?decision=approve|reject` when the server has a base URL, else `https://example.invalid/approve?id=`. **No tokens / HMAC / `sk-` secrets.** Title/reason from approval `text`/`reason`/`status`. Runs `expire_due` first. Unknown id → **404**. Unknown platform → **400** `{error:"bad_platform"}`. Not rate-limited. CORS + `X-Request-Id` same as other GET. Card button URLs are **GET** `/approvals/{id}/decide?decision=` and are **not signed** (OSS demo). Production IM adapters should POST with `X-Callback-Signature` when `callbackSecret` is set.

200.description: Platform IM POST body (Feishu interactive / DingTalk actionCard / WeCom textcard)

get.description: Runs `expire_due` first. Unknown id → **404**. CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`.

post.description: Body `{"decision":"approve"|"reject","note":"..."}`. Runs `expire_due` first; expired/not-pending → **400**. Unknown id → **404**. Audit JSONL `approval_decide`. Incoming `X-Request-Id` echoed (stored on create, not overwritten here). CORS OPTIONS unlisted Origin → **403** `cors_denied`. Optional **inbound HMAC**: when the approval's platform has `callbackSecret` (or env `FEISHU_CALLBACK_SECRET` / …), POST requires `X-Callback-Signature: sha256=<hex>` of the raw body; optional `X-Callback-Timestamp` (skew > 300s → 401 `timestamp_skew`). Missing/bad signature → **401**. Default off (unsigned POST 200). GET decide is unsigned (demo cards). Production: POST + signature. Optional outbound fire-and-forget POST `{id,status,decision,reason,requestId}` to `--webhook-url` / `APPROVAL_WEBHOOK_URL` after a successful decide (and on TTL expiry); optional HMAC `X-Webhook-Signature` when `--webhook-secret` / `APPROVAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is set. Every outbound POST includes `X-Webhook-Timestamp` (HMAC still body-only). On 5xx or network/timeout, OSS retries once after ~50ms (4xx/success no retry). Exponential backoff / queues, key rotation / timestamp replay window enforcement = paid later. Optional outbound Dify/n8n-shaped POST `{event,approval_id,status,tenant|app,title}` to `--forward-url` / `APPROVAL_FORWARD_URL` after a successful decide (and on TTL expiry); example wiring, not a Dify plugin; no secrets in the body; OSS 1 retry.

parameters.name: X-Callback-Signature
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 of the raw POST body as `sha256=<hex>` when `callbackSecret` is set for the approval platform. Required on POST only when that secret is configured. Timing-safe compare. Do not send the secret.

parameters.name: X-Callback-Timestamp
parameters.description: Optional unix-seconds. When present and |now-ts| > 300, POST decide → 401 `timestamp_skew`. Not part of the HMAC (body-only, like outbound webhooks).

get.summary: Approve or reject (unsigned GET, demo IM cards)
get.description: Query `decision=approve|reject` (optional `note`). **OSS convenience** for native IM card button URLs (those URLs cannot carry HMAC). Does **not** require `X-Callback-Signature` even when `callbackSecret` is set. Production should use **POST + signature**. Same 400/404 as POST. Not rate-limited.

XRequestId.name: X-Request-Id
XRequestId.description: Optional correlation id. Echoed on every response as `X-Request-Id`. If omitted/empty, the server generates a UUID (max 128 chars; CR/LF stripped). Also stored as `requestId` on approval records and audit JSONL when the request creates them.

ApprovalFormat.name: format
ApprovalFormat.description: Export format. `json` (default) = ApprovalList JSON (same as `GET /approvals`). `csv` = audit CSV (`id,platform,status,createdAt,decidedAt,reason`, same as `/v1/approvals.csv`). `md` = Markdown GFM table (same as `/v1/approvals.md`) for Feishu/WeCom docs. `html` = self-contained HTML list (same as `/v1/approvals.html`; no CDN; pending vs decided/expired styled).

CardPlatform.name: platform
CardPlatform.description: IM platform card shape. `feishu` (interactive), `dingtalk` (actionCard), `wecom` (textcard). Omit to use the approval record's `platform`.

XRequestId.description: Echo of incoming `X-Request-Id`, or a generated UUID when omitted/empty. Present on every response (incl 4xx / OPTIONS / 429).

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying a rate-limited webhook.

AccessControlAllowOrigin.description: Echoed when request Origin matches `CORS_ORIGINS` / `cors.origins` / `--cors-origins` (or `*` when configured). Absent when CORS disabled or origin not allowed.

shuttingDown.description: Present and true while draining SIGTERM/SIGINT. Omitted otherwise so stack-demo /health is unchanged.

FeishuWebhookRequest.description: URL verification (`type`+`challenge`) or message (`text`). `token` checked against FEISHU_VERIFY_TOKEN.

WebhookAck.description: Platform-shaped ack plus shared intent fields. Feishu challenge returns `{challenge}`.

CorsConfig.description: Optional CORS. Default omitted or empty origins = no extra CORS headers (deny). `origins` may be `["*"]` (any Origin) or an explicit list. When enabled with an explicit list, OPTIONS preflight for a non-listed Origin returns **403** `{error:"forbidden",reason:"cors_denied"}`; allowed Origin → **204** with ACAO/ACAM/ACAH. Matching GET/POST get Access-Control-Allow-Origin. Default `Access-Control-Expose-Headers` includes `Retry-After` and `X-Request-Id`. local-mvp uses `["http://localhost:3000"]`.

origins.description: `["*"]` or explicit origins. Empty/omitted disables CORS.

headers.description: Access-Control-Allow-Headers (includes X-Request-Id and IM signature headers)

ApprovalDecisionWebhook.description: Outbound fire-and-forget POST body when an approval is decided (approve/reject) or TTL-expired (`status=rejected`, `reason=expired`). Configure `--webhook-url` or `APPROVAL_WEBHOOK_URL` (config `approval_webhook_url`). Every outbound POST includes `X-Webhook-Timestamp: <unix-seconds>` (HMAC still signs the raw body only). Optional `--webhook-secret` / `APPROVAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (config `approval_webhook_secret`): when set, POST includes `X-Webhook-Signature: sha256=<hex>` (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw JSON body). Short timeout; errors never fail decide/expire. On 5xx or network/timeout, OSS retries the POST once after ~50ms (success on first try = no retry; 4xx do not retry). Simple HMAC is OSS; exponential backoff / queues, key rotation, and timestamp replay window enforcement = paid later. Not an inbound HTTP path.

requestId.description: X-Request-Id from the creating webhook, when stored

Ready.description: GET /ready body. 200 `{ok:true, service}` plus the same snapshot fields as GET /health when healthy. 503 `{ok:false, reason:"shutting_down"}` while draining SIGTERM/SIGINT. Snapshot/stateless — no circuit or queue. Compose/stack-demo healthchecks stay on `/health`.

ImCard.description: JSON body F would POST to the IM for an approval request. Feishu: `msg_type=interactive` plus `card.header` / `card.elements` (markdown + buttons). DingTalk: `msgtype=actionCard`. WeCom: `msgtype=textcard`. Never includes tokens, HMAC secrets, or `sk-` keys. additionalProperties for platform fields.

Platform.description: One configured IM connector. Booleans only for secrets — never the secret values.

id.description: Connector id (`feishu` / `dingtalk` / `wecom`, plus extras from config if present)

enabled.description: Whether this connector is currently serving `/webhook/{id}`

hasCallbackSecret.description: True when inbound decide HMAC `callbackSecret` (or platform env) is set. The secret itself is never returned.

RuntimeConfig.description: Public redacted runtime config (GET /v1/config). Allowlist only — never tokens, callbackSecret, webhook URL/secret, FEISHU_* env, or Authorization. Mirrors B GET /admin/config but F has no admin token on this GET.

approvalTtlSec.description: Pending auto-reject TTL in seconds (null if disabled)

origins.description: Allowed Origins (`["*"]` = any). Empty = CORS disabled.

webhooks.description: Outbound approval-decision webhook presence. Booleans only — never the URL (query tokens) or secret.

hasUrl.description: True when APPROVAL_WEBHOOK_URL / --webhook-url is set. The URL itself is never returned.

hasSecret.description: True when APPROVAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET / --webhook-secret is set. The secret itself is never returned.

hasForwardUrl.description: True when APPROVAL_FORWARD_URL / --forward-url is set. The URL itself is never returned.

hasForwardSecret.description: True when APPROVAL_FORWARD_SECRET / --forward-secret is set. The secret itself is never returned.

ApprovalForwardWebhook.description: Outbound fire-and-forget POST body toward a Dify / n8n webhook URL when an approval is approved or rejected (including TTL-expired). Configure `--forward-url` or `APPROVAL_FORWARD_URL` (config `approval_forward_url`). Example wiring, not a Dify plugin and not embedded orchestration. Includes `tenant` or `app` (never both). No secrets/notes/tokens. Optional HMAC (default off): `APPROVAL_FORWARD_SECRET` → `X-Webhook-Signature: sha256=<hex>` of the raw JSON body (same as B/E). Short timeout; errors never fail decide/expire. OSS 1 retry on 5xx/timeout. Not an inbound HTTP path.

tenant.description: Present when a tenant is configured (else `app` is sent).

app.description: Present when no tenant is set (bot_name / app).

title.description: Flattened approval text/title. No notes or secrets.

Unauthorized.description: Verify failed (webhook token/signature/msg_signature, or POST decide inbound callback HMAC `X-Callback-Signature` / timestamp skew). Body never includes secrets.

RateLimited.description: Webhook sliding-window rate limit exceeded (IP + platform). Retry after `Retry-After` seconds.

CorsDenied.description: CORS preflight (OPTIONS) for an Origin not in `CORS_ORIGINS` / `cors.origins` / `--cors-origins`. Body `{error:"forbidden",reason:"cors_denied"}`. No `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`. Does not apply when CORS is disabled (then OPTIONS is 404 without ACAO). GET/POST from a disallowed Origin still execute (e.g. 200/401) but omit ACAO.

BadRequest.description: Malformed JSON, invalid decision, or approval not pending / expired
